title: Fix infinite loop in admin setup error handling

requirements.summary: Fix the infinite loop in AdminSetupNotice component where 'An admin already exists' error continuously refreshes the page
acceptanceCriteria: The admin setup error no longer triggers an automatic page refresh loop
Users can see the error message without the page continuously reloading
The application remains accessible even when admin setup encounters an error
Error state is handled gracefully with a manual retry option instead of automatic refresh

file_operations.description: Remove automatic page refresh on error and replace with a manual retry mechanism. Update error handling to display the error message without triggering window.location.reload(). Add a 'Retry' button that allows users to manually retry admin setup instead of forcing an automatic refresh. Ensure error states are properly tracked to prevent re-triggering the admin setup mutation when the component re-renders.

Review the useAutoAssignAdmin and related admin setup hooks to ensure they don't automatically retry on failure. Add proper error handling configuration (retry: false) for admin setup mutations to prevent automatic retries that could contribute to the loop. Verify that the query invalidation logic doesn't trigger unnecessary refetches after errors.
